note: Export side is factually confirmed: one real outbound customs record dated 2025-10-08, Delhi Air Cargo -> Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), HS 58063200 (narrow woven fabric / 22mm man-made-fibre webbing), BOL 3916539, consignee Al Sahel Arab Industry Co. LLC. This matches the declared HS 580632 (woven narrow fabrics) — no HS correction needed. The company also imports heat-transfer/ribbon printing machinery (HS 84513090, BOL 9621380, 2024-01-11), consistent with a narrow-fabric/webbing converter rather than the claimed 'food & FMCG' industry — industry label appears wrong, HS is right. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: the web_search backend returned connection refused on both attempts and registry/aggregator pages (thecompanycheck, eximpedia, volza) returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of retrieved data is not proof of absence. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free view: null, not estimated. Address fragment seen on the record: '26 H.S.I.D.C.' (Haryana State Industrial Development Corp. estate) plus a Patparganj, Delhi port lane; legal entity existence itself was not independently confirmed from a registry in this session (out of scope here).
